Modern PHP 8.4+ DataCite REST API SDK; Saloon HTTP integration. Base namespace: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk`; Data: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk\Data`; Requests: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk\Requests`; Enums: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk\Enums`.

Use PHP 8.4+ syntax only
Add `declare(strict_types=1);` to every PHP file
Make all classes final unless inheritance is required
Use readonly properties wherever possible
Use constructor property promotion
Use typed properties and return types
Follow PSR-12 coding standards
Never use `var_dump()` or `dd()` in production code

`DataCite.php` is the main client entry point. `Requests/` holds Saloon requests by API endpoint; `Data/` holds response DTOs. Type all responses with Data DTOs. DTOs are `final readonly`. Requests extend `Saloon\Http\Request` and are `final`. Enums are backed with string or int values. Use shared traits from `Traits/`; implement `HasPaginationParams`, `HasFieldParams`, `HasIdParams`. Follow `Data/` naming conventions. Use typed arrays in DocBlocks: `<REDACTED_USER> DoiObject[]`.

Public API: default, read-only, no auth (GET). Member API: full access (POST/PUT/DELETE). Add the `RequiresMemberAuth` trait to any request class that:
Uses POST, PUT, or DELETE methods
Accesses member-specific data
Modifies DOI records

Import: `use VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk\Traits\Requests\RequiresMemberAuth;`

Create DOI: member authentication required; `final class CreateDOI extends Request`, `use RequiresMemberAuth;  // Enforces member auth requirement`, `protected Method $method = Method::POST;`

Run these commands before committing:
`composer test` - runs all tests (lint, unit, types, refactor)
`composer lint` - Laravel Pint code formatting
`composer test:unit` - Pest unit tests
`composer test:types` - PHPStan static analysis
`composer refactor` - Rector code improvements
